hook: Zuckerberg founded Facebook on February 4, 2004, and has led the company, renamed Meta Platforms in October 2021, as Chairman and CEO since its founding. He has directed Meta's Llama line of open-weight AI models and, from mid-2025, a reorganization of Meta's AI research under Meta Superintelligence Labs.
name: Mark Zuckerberg

quote.text: Openness drives innovation and is good for developers, good for Meta, and good for the world.
quote.context: Meta AI, on the release of the Llama 4 model family, Meta AI blog, April 5, 2025

moniker: Founder, Chairman and CEO of Meta

primary.name: Mark Zuckerberg, Founder, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, Meta leadership page
The Llama 4 herd, Meta AI blog, April 5, 2025

secondary.name: Meta Superintelligence Labs, Wikipedia, citing Wall Street Journal reporting

timeline.impact: Starts the company that becomes Meta Platforms.

timeline.event: Renames the company Meta Platforms in October 2021
timeline.impact: Repositions the company around AI, virtual and augmented reality alongside its social apps.

timeline.event: Releases the Llama 4 model family on April 5, 2025
timeline.impact: Extends Meta's open-weight AI model strategy with natively multimodal models.

timeline.event: Announces the formation of Meta Superintelligence Labs on June 30, 2025
timeline.impact: Consolidates Meta's AI research under one unit focused on advanced AI models.

quick_facts: Founder, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Meta Platforms
Founded Facebook on February 4, 2004, with Harvard classmates
Renamed the company Meta Platforms in October 2021
Released the Llama 4 model family under an open-weight license on April 5, 2025
Announced the formation of Meta Superintelligence Labs on June 30, 2025, to consolidate Meta's AI research

achievements.title: Llama open-weight models
achievements.impact: Directed Meta's release of successive Llama model generations, including Llama 4 Scout and Llama 4 Maverick on April 5, 2025, distributed under an open-weight license.

achievements.title: Meta Superintelligence Labs
achievements.impact: Announced June 30, 2025, reorganizing Meta's AI research and product teams into a single unit and recruiting senior researchers from other AI labs.
